[SWS_UCM_00258] Update session rejected
⌈
If State Management UpdateRequest Service Interface RequestUpdateSes-
sion method call raises error kRejected, UCM shall transition from kActivating
to kPreparing state, report FAILED to the UCM_UPDATE_SESSION_REJECTED pro-
duction error and Activate method call shall return ApplicationError kUpdate-
SessionRejected. When the update session accepted, a PASSED shall be reported
alternatively.
⌋
